findings.description: This intervention remains marked open and has no response.json, although the acceptance plan and commit message state that the operator performed the requested fast-forward. V3 requires an actual operator action or response to be recorded through the intervention resolution mechanism. Preserve and record the actual completion response if available, or remove the unsupported completion claim.

report.summary: Both prior important findings are resolved. Amendment A-2 now includes the substantive structured operator authorization, and the evaluator durably records complete per-group Warp module maps and canonical digests with focused regression coverage. No blocking or important findings remain; one intervention-record consistency issue is minor.
